📺 Doc (2025–Present)

Doc follows Dr. Amy Larsen, a brilliant but demanding physician whose life changes dramatically after a devastating car accident leaves her with eight years of missing memories. Suddenly unable to remember important relationships, personal tragedies, or major events from her past, Amy must rebuild her life while trying to return to the medical career she once dominated. As she reconnects with colleagues, family members, and former loved ones, she discovers that the person she used to be wasn’t always easy to work with or understand. Facing complicated medical cases and emotional challenges, Amy gets an unexpected opportunity to rediscover herself. Combining intense hospital emergencies, emotional storytelling, and personal mysteries, the series explores second chances, forgiveness, identity, and healing.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Mystery • Drama

⭐ IMDb: Approximately 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~43 minutes per episode

🎥 Showrunner: Barbie Kligman

🏆 Recognition: Starring Molly Parker, Omar Epps, and Jon Ecker, the series is adapted from the acclaimed Italian medical drama Doc – Nelle tue mani and has gained attention for its emotional storytelling and compelling medical mysteries.

📺 Where to Watch: FOX • Hulu • Disney+ (select regions) • Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.
